theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_ah_slice_integral_ae_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ) (H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), IntegrableOn H (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo c d) → Continuous g → tsupport g ⊆ Ioo c d → (∀ l : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 l → tsupport l ⊆ Ioo a b → ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, g p.2 * l p.1 * H p = 0) → ∀ᵐ t, t ∈ Ioo a b → ∫ α in Ioo c d, g α * H (t, α) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
